entity: SpaceX sites' injury rate vs their industry, 2025, third straight year
what_we_add: Company-wide 3.2x for 2025, Bath Iron Works 2.7x, and the Ford 11.4-vs-peers comparison - none stated by any source
why: Texas Observer puts Starbase's 2025 rate at 5x+ its industry from the same OSHA data; TechCrunch and Reuters show the same finding in earlier years. Their 5x is Starbase-only, ours 3.2x all sites - a different definition, not a contradiction.
